biography.value:
Dire Miralis

Gargantuan Dragon (Elder), Unaligned — Challenge 11 (Boss; ~10,000 XP)

An Elder Dragon of boiling seas and volcanic vents. Place the token in the arena, roll initiative, and use the features on the sheet. Magma Armor, lava templates, Calamity Rain interrupt/detonation, Boiling Presence, and Scorching Hide run from the Amellwind module script.

Combat notes

  • Stance: starts Biped (15-ft Claw, Crush). Shift Stance (legendary) toggles Quadruped (Tail Sweep, advantage vs prone).
  • Magma Armor: arms below 70% HP (161/230). Cold damage or an interrupted Calamity Rain cracks it; six cracks shatter it.
  • Calamity Rain: target up to six spaces, Charge, then either 40+ damage in one turn interrupts or Greater Fireball detonates on each marker at the start of its next turn.
  • Lair actions (optional, initiative 20): cannot repeat the same effect two rounds in a row.
biography.public: A gargantuan Elder Dragon whose presence boils the sea.

description.value: The Dire Miralis can breathe air and water.
description.chat: The Dire Miralis can breathe air and water.

description.value: Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the Dire Miralis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
description.chat: The Dire Miralis succeeds on a failed saving throw.

description.value: The Dire Miralis deals double damage to objects and structures.
description.chat: Double damage to objects and structures.

description.value:
The Dire Miralis radiates furnace heat. At the start of each of the Dire Miralis's turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

Automated by the Amellwind module script at the start of its turn.
description.chat: Creatures within 10 feet take 1d10 fire damage at the start of the Dire Miralis's turn.

effects.name: Boiling Presence (10 ft)
effects.description: Furnace heat. Nearby creatures take 1d10 fire at the start of the Dire Miralis's turn.

description.value:
Any creature that enters or starts its turn in boiling/tainted water within 60 feet of the Dire Miralis takes 11 (2d10) fire damage. That water is difficult terrain for creatures other than the Dire Miralis.

Lava and tainted-water templates placed by Magma Glob, Volcanic Vents, and lair actions are automated. Mark other boiling water with those templates as needed.
description.chat: Boiling/tainted water within 60 ft: 2d10 fire on enter or start of turn; difficult terrain.

description.value:
At the end of each of the Dire Miralis's turns, choose up to two spaces the Dire Miralis can see within 60 feet. Each creature in those spaces must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) fire damage. Those spaces become lava until the start of the Dire Miralis's next turn (see Magma Glob).

Place up to two 5-foot squares (empty or occupied). Creatures in those spaces make the save. Lava templates expire at the start of its next turn.
description.chat: DC 17 Dexterity vs 2d8 fire in up to two spaces; those spaces become lava.

activation.condition: End of the Dire Miralis's turn

macro.name: Volcanic Vents

description.value:
When the Dire Miralis is reduced below 70% hit points, its hide hardens into a slag shell. While Magma Armor is active:

  • Its AC becomes 22.
  • It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

Cracking the Shell. Magma Armor cracks (the Dire Miralis loses the resistance—and its AC returns to 18—until the end of its next turn) when any of the following happens:

  1. It takes cold damage, or
  2. The hunters interrupt Calamity Rain.

If Magma Armor has been cracked six times, the shell shatters: Magma Armor ends and can't return for the rest of the combat. Detonating Calamity Rain also cracks the shell once from heat shock (if it was active).

Armed automatically from the module script.
description.chat: Below 70% HP: AC 22 and resistance to B/P/S until cracked or shattered.

effects.name: Magma Armor
effects.description: AC 22. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

effects.name: Cracked Shell
effects.description: Magma Armor is cracked. AC 18; no physical resistance until the end of the Dire Miralis's next turn.

description.value:
The Dire Miralis uses one stance at a time and can change it with Shift Stance.

  • Biped: melee reach 15 feet; can use Crush.
  • Quadruped: melee reach 10 feet; can use Tail Sweep; advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone.

Starts in Biped. Claw reach updates when the stance changes.
description.chat: Biped: 15-ft reach, Crush. Quadruped: 10-ft reach, Tail Sweep, advantage vs prone.

effects.name: Biped Stance
effects.description: Melee reach 15 feet. Crush is available.

effects.name: Quadruped Stance
effects.description: Melee reach 10 feet. Tail Sweep is available. Advantage on saves against being knocked prone.

description.value: The Dire Miralis makes two attacks, using Claw, Magma Glob, or one of each.
description.chat: Two attacks: Claw, Magma Glob, or one of each.

description.value:
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. (15 ft. in Biped), one target.

Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

Reach is updated automatically when the Dire Miralis changes stance.
description.chat: +11 to hit, 4d8+7 slashing + 1d8 fire.

description.value:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target.

Hit: 27 (5d10) fire damage, and the target's space becomes lava for 1 hour. On a miss, the lava appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target.

A creature that enters the lava or starts its turn there takes 11 (2d10) fire damage. The lava ignites flammable objects not being worn or carried.
description.chat: +7 to hit, 5d10 fire; space becomes lava (miss: adjacent space).

macro.name: Magma Glob

description.value:
Biped Only. The Dire Miralis slams down in a 20-foot-by-20-foot square originating from an edge of its space. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice).

Failure: 18 (4d8) bludgeoning + 18 (4d8) fire damage, and the creature is knocked prone.

Success: half damage, not prone, and the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area (or falls prone in the Dire Miralis's space if none exists).
description.chat: Biped. 20-ft square, DC 19 Str/Dex: 4d8 bludgeoning + 4d8 fire, prone on a fail.

description.value: Recharge 5–6. The Dire Miralis exhales a massive fireball centered on a point it can see within 150 feet. Each creature in a 25-foot-radius sphere must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (11d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
description.chat: Recharge 5–6. 25-ft radius, 150 ft, DC 17 Dex, 11d6 fire.

description.value:
1/Day; Enrage Nova.

Charge (action): The Dire Miralis coils and glows. Until the start of its next turn it is visibly charging. Place six glowing markers in spaces it can see within 120 feet. While charging, it can't take reactions, and damage it takes is tallied for the interrupt.

Interrupt: If the Dire Miralis takes 40 or more damage in one turn during the charge (before detonation), the nova fails. It is knocked prone, Magma Armor cracks (if active), and it can't use Legendary Actions until the end of its next turn.

Detonation (start of its next turn, if not interrupted): Greater Fireball erupts on each detonation zone. After detonating, Magma Armor cracks once from the heat shock (if it was active).

Target up to six tokens/spaces as markers, then use Charge. Interrupt and detonation are automated.
description.chat: Charge: 6 markers within 120 ft. 40+ damage in one turn interrupts. Else Greater Fireball on each zone.

effects.name: Calamity Rain — Charging
effects.description: Coiling and glowing. Cannot take reactions. 40+ damage in one turn interrupts the nova.

macro.name: Calamity Rain

description.value: The Dire Miralis moves up to half its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks if it ends the move in water or adjacent to a structure or Huge or larger object.
description.chat: Bonus action: move half speed. No OA if it ends in water or next to a structure / Huge+ object.

description.value:
Arena Lair Action (Tainted Sea Cove) — Optional. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties).

Boiling water or lava spreads 10 feet inland from the current waterline along a 40-foot-wide front. New spaces use Boiling Presence / lava hazards.

Cannot use the same lair effect two rounds in a row.
description.chat: Lair: 40-ft front of boiling water / lava spreads 10 ft inland.

macro.name: Lair: Rising Magma Tide

description.value:
Arena Lair Action (Tainted Sea Cove) — Optional. On initiative count 20.

One shipwreck section within 60 feet partially collapses. Creatures in a 15-foot square there must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be restrained (escape DC 17). The area becomes difficult terrain and provides half cover afterward.

Cannot use the same lair effect two rounds in a row.
description.chat: Lair: 15-ft square, DC 17 Dex, 4d6 bludgeoning and restrained; difficult terrain + half cover.

macro.name: Lair: Wreck Collapse

description.value:
Arena Lair Action (Tainted Sea Cove) — Optional. On initiative count 20.

A scalding steam cloud fills a 20-foot cube the Dire Miralis can see within 60 feet until initiative count 20 on the next round. The area is heavily obscured; any creature that starts its turn there takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

Cannot use the same lair effect two rounds in a row.
description.chat: Lair: 20-ft cube of steam, heavily obscured, 2d6 fire at start of turn.

macro.name: Lair: Blood-Red Steam
